Fact.Name: State return: Pennsylvania
Fact.Description: #78 state framework: the filer chose Pennsylvania as the one state they lived in and earned income in (full-year). Add /stateReturnIs{XX} per state (e.g. #81 FL).

Fact.Name: State return: Pennsylvania part-year resident
Fact.Description: #80: lived in PA for part of the year and in FL for the rest (paPit /paPartYearSupported). PA-40 IN (2025) p. 6, (P) Part-Year Resident.

Fact.Name: State return: Pennsylvania (full-year or part-year)
Fact.Description: #80: a PA-40 is computed, either as a full-year resident (#78) or a PA/FL part-year resident.

Fact.Name: State return computed by this tool
Fact.Description: #78 state framework: true when this tool computes the resident state return. Add each computed state to the Any.

Fact.Name: stateTaxLiability
Fact.Description: #78 state framework: State tax liability (PA-40 line 12). Undefined when no state return is computed.

Fact.Name: stateTaxWithheld
Fact.Description: #78 state framework: State tax withheld (PA-40 line 13). Undefined when no state return is computed.

Fact.Name: stateRefund
Fact.Description: #78 state framework: State overpayment (PA-40 line 29). Undefined when no state return is computed.

Fact.Name: stateAmountOwed
Fact.Description: #78 state framework: State tax due (PA-40 line 26). Undefined when no state return is computed.

Fact.Name: Flow knockout: state return items not supported
Fact.Description: #78 state framework: any knockout of the computed state return. Each state adds All(/stateReturnIs{XX}, its knockouts). Wired into flow.xml /flowIsKnockedOut.
